_about: Commander release periods (owner decision 2, produto/backlog-pos-ux.md). `period` = when the commander first becomes obtainable in a new kingdom, in game order: launch (from kingdom start) < pre_kvk (Preparation Season, before KvK1) < kvk1 < kvk2 < kvk3 < soc. `offseasonUnlock` = it unlocks in the offseason just before that season. `confidence`: high = an official note (T1) names it and nothing conflicts; medium = one T2 source, a T1 line plus inference, or two independent sources agree; low = a single T3 source, or sources conflict (`conflict: true`; the period then follows the newest official note). `facts` are research/facts card IDs (sources and quotes live there); `lastConfirmed` = newest source date behind the period.
